is_anopheles.evidence: The study tests Anopheles coluzzii, Anopheles gambiae s.s., and An. gambiae Kisumu (page 2, 5).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Page 3 mentions quantifying kdr resistance using PCR based on Martinez-Torres et al. 1998 (Vgsc L995F / L1014F): 'The kdr mutation reduces sensitivity to DDT and pyrethroids... The levels of kdr resistance in wild-caught An. coluzzii and An. gambiae s.s. were 98.3% and 92.9%, respectively (Supplementary Table 1).'

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The main text reports only percentages (98.3% and 92.9% kdr resistance) without mosquito sample sizes (N), genotype counts, or allele counts in the main text; it refers readers to Supplementary Table 1, which is not provided.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were reared from larval collections at Vallée du Kou and Soumousso in Burkina Faso (page 5).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research paper evaluating transgenic Metarhizium pingshaense efficacy against mosquitoes.

sub_country_location.evidence: Page 5 specifies exact coordinates and locations in Burkina Faso: 'Vallée du Kou (11°23′N, 4°24′W) and Soumousso (11°04′N, 4°03′W)'.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No mosquito collection months or years are reported anywhere in the main text.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Larvae were collected directly from natural breeding sites in Burkina Faso specifically for this study.

supplement.evidence: Genotype sample sizes and counts are located in 'Supplementary Table 1' (page 3: 'The levels of kdr resistance in wild-caught An. coluzzii and An. gambiae s.s. were 98.3% and 92.9%, respectively (Supplementary Table 1)'), which was not provided.

assessment.summary: This study tested the efficacy of transgenic Metarhizium pingshaense expressing arthropod toxins against wild insecticide-resistant Anopheles coluzzii and An. gambiae s.s. from Burkina Faso. Although kdr (Vgsc L995F) resistance frequencies are mentioned (98.3% and 92.9%), no sample sizes or genotype counts are included in the main text, referencing an unprovided Supplementary Table 1.
exclusion_reasons: Lacks extractable genotype counts or frequencies with sample size (N) in the provided text (data resides in Supplementary Table 1).
